coreStoreProfile.name: TRYAMM Core
coreStoreProfile.reason: The normal App Store/Play candidate must not accidentally ship an undeclared or unreviewed system VPN capability.

distribution.appleAppStore: core profile now; VPN profile only after entitlement/review certification
distribution.googlePlay: core profile now; VPN profile only after Play VPN declaration/review certification
distribution.allAmericanAppStore: may distribute TRYAMM packages, but cannot bypass Android/iOS platform permissions, entitlements, user consent or security rules
distribution.pwa: TRYAMM-only HTTPS/private API path; no system-wide VPN

earningsBoundary: VPN traffic never earns Pocket Edge money. Only verified funded compute jobs can create Edge earnings.
